question: P can cover a certain distance in 4 hours 40 minutes by covering two-third of the distance at 4 km/h and the remaining distance at 5 km/h. 25% of the total distance (in km) covered by P is:
solution:
**Given:**

The time taken by P to cover a certain distance = 4 hour 40 minutes

The speed of covering two-thirds distance = 4 km/h

The speed of covering the rest distance = 5 km/h

**Concept used:**

Time = Distance/Speed

**Calculation:**

Let the total distance be 3D km.

The two-third distance of 3D = (2/3) × 3D

⇒ 2D

According to the question,

(2D)/(4)+(D)/(5) = 4 hours and 40 minutes or (14)/(3) hours [As 1 hour = 60 minutes]

⇒ (10D+4D)/(20) = (14)/(3)

⇒ (14D)/(20) = (14)/(3)

⇒ (D)/(20) = (1)/(3)

⇒ D = (20)/(3)

⇒ 3D = 20

So, total distance = 20 km

25% of 20 km = 20 × 25% = 5 km

**∴ ****25% of the total distance (in km) covered by P is 5.**
